title: NSIS: Add a certification page
description:
Add a certification page and display it in the Wireshark installer
instead of the donation page. Enable the donation page in the
Stratoshark installer.

(cherry picked from commit 463233df63a3d4af3e4fa300409823243fb3ad33)

changes_data.diff:
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+[Settings]
+NumFields=2
+
+[Field 1]
+Type=Label
+Left=10
+Right=250
+Top=10
+Bottom=34
+Text=The WCA is designed to formally recognize engineers who demonstrate professional-level proficiency in network protocol analysis and advanced troubleshooting using Wireshark.
+
+[Field 2]
+Type=Link
+Left=10
+Right=250
+Top=50
+Bottom=58
+Text=You can learn more at https://www.wireshark.org/certifications.
+State=https://www.wireshark.org/certifications

@@ -86,6 +86,8 @@ BrandingText "Stratoshark${U+00ae} Installer"
 !define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_BUTTON "Noted"
 !insertmacro MUI_PAGE_LICENSE "${STAGING_DIR}\COPYING.txt"
 
+Page custom DisplayDonatePage
+
 !insertmacro MUI_PAGE_COMPONENTS
 !ifdef QT_DIR
 Page custom DisplayAdditionalTasksPage LeaveAdditionalTasksPage
@@ -110,7 +112,7 @@ Page custom DisplayAdditionalTasksPage LeaveAdditionalTasksPage
   ; Old Modern 1 UI: https://nsis.sourceforge.io/Docs/Modern%20UI/Readme.html

-  ;ReserveFile "DonatePage.ini"
+  ReserveFile "DonatePage.ini"
   ReserveFile /plugin InstallOptions.dll
 
   ; Modern UI 2 / nsDialog pages.
@@ -413,6 +415,7 @@ done:
 
   ;Extract InstallOptions INI files
   ;!insertmacro INSTALLOPTIONS_EXTRACT "AdditionalTasksPage.ini"
+  !insertmacro INSTALLOPTIONS_EXTRACT "DonatePage.ini"
 FunctionEnd

@@ -421,10 +424,10 @@ Function DisplayAdditionalTasksPage
 FunctionEnd

-; Function DisplayDonatePage
-;   !insertmacro MUI_HEADER_TEXT "Your donations keep these releases coming" "Donate today"
-;   !insertmacro INSTALLOPTIONS_DISPLAY "DonatePage.ini"
-; FunctionEnd

+  !insertmacro MUI_HEADER_TEXT "Your donations keep these releases coming" "Donate today!"
+  !insertmacro INSTALLOPTIONS_DISPLAY "DonatePage.ini"
+FunctionEnd
 
 ; ============================================================================
 ; Installation execution commands

@@ -95,7 +95,8 @@ BrandingText "Wireshark${U+00ae} Installer"
 !define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_BUTTON "Noted"

   ;ReserveFile "AdditionalTasksPage.ini"
-  ReserveFile "DonatePage.ini"

   ReserveFile "NpcapPage.ini"

   ReserveFile /plugin InstallOptions.dll
@@ -485,7 +487,8 @@ done:

-  !insertmacro INSTALLOPTIONS_EXTRACT "DonatePage.ini"
+  ;!insertmacro INSTALLOPTIONS_EXTRACT "DonatePage.ini"

   !insertmacro INSTALLOPTIONS_EXTRACT "NpcapPage.ini"

+; Function DisplayDonatePage
